content.intro: In this lesson, you will study building a smaller custom bootstrap bundle and connect it to a small implementation or review task. The included subtopics preserve the attached Bootstrap curriculum outline.
content.why_it_matters: Building a Smaller Custom Bootstrap Bundle is a customization capability. Prefer built-in utilities first, then CSS variables for local changes, and Sass/build customization only when the design needs generated framework changes.
